title: Mrs. Synigal's birth in the family home on Coord Street
summary: She was born in New Orleans in the house where her father and grandmother's other grandchildren were also born, a family custom.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You know what, we forgot to ask where you were born. I was born here in New Orleans. And as I said before, we have such customs. The house that I was born in, my father was born in. And my grandmother saw to it that all her children's children were born there. So, we were all born at 1510 Coord Street. My father and sisters and brothers. My grandmother went there as a bride. So she had all her children there and the children's children. She didn't care after the children were born. She said, now fine, get homes for yourself. But I wanted them to be born.
